conclusion: 两轮独立复现。源串（data/general/objects/boss-artifacts-far-east.lua:294，define_as="WHIP_URH_ROK"，commit:624a6732）为 "With this unbearably bright whip of flame, the demon master Urh'Rok has become known for never having lost in combat."，译文「用这根炽焰打造的鞭子，恶魔领主乌鲁洛克未尝一败。」丢掉两项信息：(1) unbearably bright（亮得令人无法直视）整个修饰语消失，而这是本神器唯一的外观描写；(2) whip of flame 是「由火焰构成的鞭子」，译文「炽焰打造的鞭子」改成以火焰为材料锻造，物性不同。宿主已核实该 desc 为纯 flavor 文本（同条目 combat/wielder 字段不含 light/blind 机制），故判为描写信息缺失而非机制错误，但缺失幅度已超出措辞偏好 → confirmed。修复方向：「这根由火焰构成、亮得令人无法直视的长鞭，让恶魔领主乌鲁洛克以战无不胜闻名。」

newEntity{ base = "BASE_LONGBOW",
	power_source = {arcane=true},
	define_as = "STORM_FURY",
	name = "Storm Fury", unique=true,
	unided_name = _t"crackling longbow", color=colors.BLUE, image = "object/artifact/storm_fury.png",
	desc = _t[[This dragonbone longbow is enhanced with bands of steel, which arc with intense lightning. Bolts travel up and down the string, ignorant of you.]],
	require = { stat = { dex=30, mag=30 }, },
	level_range = {40, 50},
	rarity = 250,
	cost = 300,
	material_level = 5,
	sentient = true,
	special_desc = function(self, who)		
		local dam = (40+ who:getMag())
		local dam2 = (40+ who:getMag()) * 2
		return ("Automatically fires lightning bolts every game turn at nearby enemies dealing %d to %d lightning damage based on Magic with a chance to inflict Daze."):
			tformat(dam, dam2)
	end,
	combat = {
		range = 10,
		talent_on_hit = { T_CHAIN_LIGHTNING = {level=3, chance=12},},
	},
	wielder = {
		combat_spellpower = 30,
		combat_spellcrit = 10,
		inc_stats = { [Stats.STAT_MAG] = 10, [Stats.STAT_DEX] = 10},
		combat_def = 30,
		ranged_project = {[DamageType.LIGHTNING] = 75},
		talents_types_mastery = {
			["spell/air"] = 0.5,  -- High values because these stats are only relevant to casters, sort of the counterpart to the Chain Lightning on hit
			["spell/storm"] = 0.5,
		},
		inc_damage={
			[DamageType.LIGHTNING] = 25,
		},
		resists={
			[DamageType.LIGHTNING] = 20,
		},
		movement_speed = 0.3,
	},
	act = function(self)
		self:useEnergy()
		if not self.worn_by then return end
		if game.zone.wilderness then return end
		if game.level and not game.level:hasEntity(self.worn_by) then self.worn_by = nil return end
		if self.worn_by:attr("dead") then return end
		local who = self.worn_by
		local Map = require "engine.Map"
		local tgts = {}
		local DamageType = require "engine.DamageType"
		local grids = core.fov.circle_grids(who.x, who.y, 5, true)
		for x, yy in pairs(grids) do for y, _ in pairs(grids[x]) do
			local a = game.level.map(x, y, Map.ACTOR)
			if a and who:reactionToward(a) < 0 then
				tgts[#tgts+1] = a
			end
		end end

		local tg = {type="hit", range=5, friendlyfire=false}
		for i = 1, 1 do
			if #tgts <= 0 then break end
			local a, id = rng.table(tgts)
			table.remove(tgts, id)

			who:project(tg, a.x, a.y, engine.DamageType.LIGHTNING_DAZE, {daze=40, dam = who:spellCrit(rng.avg(1,2) * (40+ who:getMag()))} )
			game.level.map:particleEmitter(who.x, who.y, math.max(math.abs(a.x-who.x), math.abs(a.y-who.y)), "lightning", {tx=a.x-who.x, ty=a.y-who.y})
			game:playSoundNear(self, "talents/lightning")
			who:logCombat(a, "#GOLD#A bolt of lightning fires from #Source#'s bow, striking #Target#!")
		end
	end,
	on_wear = function(self, who)
		self.worn_by = who
	end,
	on_takeoff = function(self)
		self.worn_by = nil
	end,
}

		inc_stats = { [Stats.STAT_MAG] = 12,},
		combat_def = 12,
		on_melee_hit = {[DamageType.ICE]=60},
	},
	max_power = 30, power_regen = 1,
	use_power = {
		name = function(self, who)
			local dam = who:damDesc(engine.DamageType.COLD, self.use_power.damage(self, who))
			return ("release a radius %d chilling blast, instantly dealing %0.2f cold damage and condensing the air into freezing vapors that deal %0.2f cold damage (based on Magic) each turn for %d turns"):tformat(self.use_power.radius, dam*3, dam, self.use_power.duration)
		end,
		power = 30,
		damage = function(self, who) return 25 + who:getMag() end,
		radius = 4,
		tactical = {ATTACKAREA = {COLD = 2},
			DISABLE = {STUN = 1.5}},
		target = function(self, who) return {type="ball", range=0, radius=self.use_power.radius, selffire=false, display={particle="bolt_ice", trail="icetrail"}} end,
		requires_target = true,
		no_npc_use = function(self, who) return self:restrictAIUseObject(who) end,
		duration = 10,
		use = function(self, who)
			local duration = self.use_power.duration
			local radius = self.use_power.radius
			local dam = self.use_power.damage(self, who)
			local blast = self.use_power.target(self, who)
			game.logSeen(who, "%s releases an icy blast from %s %s!", who:getName():capitalize(), who:his_her(), self:getName({do_color = true, no_add_name = true}))
			who:project(blast, who.x, who.y, engine.DamageType.COLD, dam*3)
			who:project(blast, who.x, who.y, engine.DamageType.FREEZE, {dur=6, hp=80+dam})
			game.level.map:particleEmitter(who.x, who.y, blast.radius, "iceflash", {radius=blast.radius})
			-- Add a lasting map effect
			local eff = game.level.map:addEffect(who,
				who.x, who.y, duration,
				engine.DamageType.ICE, dam,
				radius,
				5, nil,
				engine.MapEffect.new{color_br=255, color_bg=255, color_bb=255, effect_shader="shader_images/ice_effect.png"},
				function(e, update_shape_only)
					if not update_shape_only then e.radius = e.radius end
					return true
				end,
				false
			)
			eff.name = _t"icy vapors"
			return {id=true, used=true}
		end
	},
}

conclusion: 表层报 "and flushed out to sea"（被水冲入海中）译成「并被扔进海里」改变了动作含义，交叉复核判 OK，单轮孤证。宿主核实（data/zones/murgol-lair/npcs.lua:30，commit:624a6732）：该串是 MURGOL（Murgol, the Yaech Lord）的 `killer_message`，即死亡描述的后半句，纯叙述、无机制含义。flushed out（被水流冲走）与「被扔进」（有人施力投掷）确有施事差别，但这属于意象层面的措辞偏差，不会误导任何玩法决策，未达缺陷门槛 → advisory，不进入修复。登记备查：若日后统一整理死亡描述表，可一并改为「并被冲入海中」。

表层报 Wanderer 职业解锁文本中 "in no way meant to be balanced" 被译成「没有经过任何的平衡测试」，把「不以平衡为设计目标」写成「未做平衡测试」这一关于开发过程的事实断言；交叉复核判 OK，单轮孤证。宿主核实源串确为 "They are a #{bold}#bonus#{normal}# class, in no way meant to be balanced or even working with all possible talent combos."：指控在语义上成立（设计意图 ≠ 测试事实），但两种写法给玩家的实际提示一致（这是奖励职业、别指望平衡、风险自负），不改变任何玩法决策 → advisory，不进入修复。登记备查：理想译法为「他们是#{bold}#奖励#{normal}#职业，本就不以平衡为目标，也不保证能与所有技能组合正常配合。」

两轮独立复现，属高影响机制缺陷。源串（data/talents/chronomancy/timetravel.lua:218 的 Time Skip info，commit:624a6732）为 "If your target survives, it may be removed from time for %d turns."，译文「如果你的目标存活，他将被从这个时空放逐 %d 回合。」把 may 删成必然。宿主已逐行核实 action 函数：:143-145 `if target:attr("timetravel_immune") then ... return true end`；:155 `if target.dead or target.player then return true end`；:157-160 `local hit = self:checkHit(power, target:combatSpellResist() + (target:attr("continuum_destabilization") or 0))` 与 `if not hit then ... "%s resists!" ... return true end`；:168 地形阻挡时 `Something has prevented the timetravel` 亦直接返回。四条分支任一成立都只结算伤害、不放逐。译文承诺必然放逐会直接诱导错误的战术决策（把 Time Skip 当作确定性控制技使用），属 [[dropped-modal-qualifier-is-a-defect-class]] → confirmed。修复方向：「如果你的目标存活，它有几率被从这个时空放逐 %d 回合。」

		end
	end,

		local tg = self:getTalentTarget(t)
		local x, y, target = self:getTarget(tg)
		if not x or not y then return nil end
		local _ _, x, y = self:canProject(tg, x, y)
		
		local target = game.level.map(x, y, game.level.map.ACTOR)
		
		if not target then return end
		local targets = self:archeryAcquireTargets(tg, {x=target.x, y=target.y})

		local dam = t.getDamage(self,t)
		self:archeryShoot(targets, t, {type = "hit", speed = 200, primaryeffect=tg.radius, primarytarget=target}, {mult=dam})
		
		--acquire secondary targets
		if target:hasEffect(target.EFF_MARKED) or self:isTalentActive(self.T_CONCEALMENT) then 
			local targets = {}
			local add_target = function(x, y)
				local t2 = game.level.map(x, y, game.level.map.ACTOR)

				end
			end	
			if target:hasEffect(target.EFF_MARKED) then 
				target:removeEffect(target.EFF_MARKED)
				if self:knowTalent(self.T_BULLSEYE) then self:callTalent(self.T_BULLSEYE, "proc") end
			end
		end 
		return true

"%s resists!" ... return true end`；:168 地形阻挡时 `Something has prevented the timetravel` 亦直接返回。四条分支任一成立都只结算伤害、不放逐。译文承诺必然放逐会直接诱导错误的战术决策（把 Time Skip 当作确定性控制技使用），属 [[dropped-modal-qualifier-is-a-defect-class]] → confirmed。修复方向：「如果你的目标存活，它有几率被从这个时空放逐 %d 回合。」

					tids[#tids+1] = tid
					talentcount = talentcount + 1
				end
			end
		
			talentcount = math.min(talentcount, t.getTalentCount(self,t))
			
			for i = 1, talentcount do
					if #tids == 0 then break end
					local tid = rng.tableRemove(tids)
					self.talents_cd[tid] = self.talents_cd[tid] - t.getCooldown(self,t)
					if self.talents_cd[tid] <= 0 then self.talents_cd[tid] = nil end
			end
				
			self:startTalentCooldown(t)
		end
		return true
	end,
	info = function(self, t)
		local speed = t.getSpeed(self,t)*100
		local nb = t.getTalentCount(self,t)
		local cd = t.getCooldown(self,t)
		return ([[Each time you consume a mark, you gain %d%% increased attack speed for 2 turns and the cooldown of %d random techniques are reduced by %d turns.]]):
		tformat(speed, nb, cd)
	end,
}
